body:
## What to build

Support admitted column and scalar-summary names that R interprets as signed or whitespace dot-dot references when marginplyr generates internal reads. Ordinary fixed-key selection and contextual-share source lookup must retain the caller's actual name.

At main `59d55a7867ffc0255f75be32a233d9d475bcb7fb`, use two rows g=a,b and x=1,3. Name a scalar sum ..-1 and request its Total share under a rollup of g. Ordinary dplyr summarize and the same Margin summary without a share both return values 1,3,4. Adding the share fails when the package's generated denominator projection reads that name through the data pronoun, reporting indexing '...' with non-positive index -1. Parent shares and the corresponding dtplyr source show the same gap.

An input fixed key named ..-1 is another public path: ordinary dplyr fixed-key selection succeeds, while the Margin summary fails when making its private key copy, even without a share. Local source names ..-0, ..+1, ..+0, and .. 1 also reproduced the source-read gap. These spellings are accepted by ordinary output/selection interfaces and are outside the repository's intentional upstream exclusion for ... and positive ..j input names.

The internal special-name predicate protects unsigned digit dot-dot names only, so generated data-pronoun reads for these admitted names bypass the existing alias boundary. Their failure is not evidence that a wider output name repair is needed. This is independent of the dtplyr fixed-key staging ticket: local execution and source-summary lookup already reproduce it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both share helpers accept a uniquely defined numeric scalar source named ..-1 on local and dtplyr inputs, returning the documented double ratios.
- [ ] Local fixed keys with admitted signed/whitespace dot-dot spellings aggregate successfully with and without shares, preserving partition identity and public names.
- [ ] Exercise the confirmed ..-0, ..+1, ..+0, and .. 1 source spellings and the relevant generated-read boundaries.
- [ ] Preserve genuine source eligibility/cardinality refusals and intentional upstream restrictions on unsupported input names.
- [ ] Keep lazy inputs lazy and caller data unchanged; add public regression coverage without suppressing backend diagnostics.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[Reproduction, ordinary-summary controls, and name-reading boundary](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/8b3943d716fc6ed8300d81eaab0c8ae2a52619fb/investigation/summary-spec-share-bughunt-2026-10-29.md#f5-signed-dot-dot-names-bypassed-internal-read-protection). Investigated on 2026-10-29; no implementation repair was included.
title: [P2] Protect signed dot-dot names in generated local column reads
